snippet.title: The Signal: Stranded on Sirenis - Demo Reveal Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom
snippet.description:
A brand new trailer for The Signal: Stranded on Sirenis, a single player survival game set on a captivating but deadly alien planet. 
The new trailer reveals that a demo will be dropping on October 13th, and the game is available to wishlist now on Steam. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #thesignalstrandedonsirenis
